assertion: An event exists, described as "Jewelry theft from Lalique museum".
judge_quote: Burglars stole millions of dollars worth of jewelry from the museum of French luxury glassmaker Lalique in a daring early-morning raid on Sunday
evidence_cited: Burglars stole millions of dollars worth of jewelry from the museum of French luxury glassmaker Lalique in a daring early-morning raid on Sunday...
A gang of masked thieves broke in to the museum in Wingen-sur-Moder... around 5:30 am...

assertion: An event exists, described as "Louvre museum heist".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Adrien Dubouche National Museum heist".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Cognacq-Jay museum heist".

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Lalique museum closure".

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Louvre security audit finding".

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Cognacq-Jay museum insurance payment".

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Estimated theft value of several million euros".

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Masked thieves stole 20 pieces of jewelry".
judge_quote: A gang of masked thieves broke in to the museum in Wingen-sur-Moder in northeastern France around 5:30 am, forcing a door before heading for the jewelry room and smashing open six display cases, a source close to the investigation told AFP.
Around twenty pieces of jewelry were stolen.
evidence_cited: Around twenty pieces of jewelry were stolen...

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Security company failed to respond promptly".
judge_quote: An alarm went off, but by the time the security company had completed its checks, it was a cleaning lady who arrived first on the scene and called the police.
